description: Change a Lamoi site besides page text: menu, colours, an image from a public URL, SEO title and description, or undo the last connector change. action tokens, media, snapshots and audit are reads. action colors, menu, image, seo and undo need confirm. Use oma_waas_page for page body text. serviceId comes from oma_waas_sites. Do not use oma_wp_*.

action.description: tokens, media, snapshots and audit are reads. colors, menu, image, seo and undo need confirm.

items.description: menu: each item has a label and a page id or an https url.

noindex.description: seo: hide the page from search engines.

pageId.description: seo: page id, or omit for the whole site.

serviceId.description: The Lamoi site's service id (from oma_waas_sites).

source.description: image: where the picture came from.
